[[Wing, Three Blade]] is a [[Jade Brotherhood]] boss that appears in [[Bukdek Byway]].

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Bukdek Byway}}
**{{NPC location|Wajjun Bazaar}} (only during [[Deactivating P.O.X.]])

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|"Watch Yourself!"}}
*{{skill icon|Cyclone Axe}}
*{{skill icon|Furious Axe}}
*{{skill icon|Healing Signet}}
*{{skill icon|Triple Chop}} ([[elite]])

==Dialogue==
During [[Deactivating P.O.X.]]
:''"How many [[Am Fah]] does it take to kill a [[Yeti]]? None! They cannot figure out how to leave the sewers to find one!"''

==Items dropped==
*[[Bolt of Cloth]]
*[[Bolt of Silk]]
*[[Jadeite Shard]]
*[[Jade Bracelet]]
*[[Jade Brotherhood Armguard]]
*[[Wing's Axe]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* Wing will not spawn in Bukdek Byway if the quest [[Chasing Zenmai]] appears in your [[quest log]]
* He is an ally during [[Deactivating P.O.X.]]
** The easiest way to capture [[Triple Chop]] is to let him die ''during the quest'' and capture it afterwards. 
** Alternatively, after he turns hostile, you can lure him down the stairs and past the peasants; once you force him to break aggro, he will be left stuck against a wall.

{{bug|He sometimes gets trapped in the walls, preventing you from reaching any [[drop]]s once he is killed.}}
